Logon ke liye hisaab ka waqt aa pahuncha hai aur woh abhi ghaflat hi mein pade hue hain aur kinaara-kashi kiye ja rahe hain
Un ke paas un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se koi nayi yaad-dahaani nahin aati magar yeh ke kaan laga kar sun lete hain aur phir khel tamaashe mein lag jaate hain

Un ke dil bilkul ghaafil ho gaye hain, aur yeh zaalim is tarah aapas mein raaz o niyaaz ki baatein kiya karte hain ke yeh bhi to tumhaare hi tarah ke ek insaan hain, kya tum deeda o daanista un ke jaadoo ke chakkar mein aa rahe ho
To paighambar ne jawaab diya ke mera Parwardigar aasmaan o zameen ki tamaam baaton ko jaanta hai, woh khoob sunne waala aur jaanne waala hai

Balke yeh log kehte hain ke yeh to sab khwaab-e-pareshaan ka majmooa hai, balke yeh khud paighambar ki taraf se iftira hai, balke yeh shaa'ir hain aur shaa'iri kar rahe hain, warna aisi nishaani le kar aate jaisi nishaani le kar pehle paighambar bheje gaye the
Un se pehle hum ne jin bastiyon ko sarkashi ki bina par tabaah kar daala woh to imaan laayi nahin, yeh kya imaan laayenge
Aur hum ne aap se pehle bhi jin rasoolon ko bheja hai woh sab mard hi the jin ki taraf hum wahi kiya karte the. To tum log agar nahin jaante ho to jaanne waalon se daryaaft kar lo
Aur hum ne un logon ke liye bhi koi aisa jism nahin banaaya tha jo khaana na khaata ho, aur woh bhi hamesha rehne waale nahin the
Phir hum ne un ke waade ko sach kar dikhaaya, aur inhein aur un ke saath jin ko chaaha bacha liya, aur zyaadati karne waalon ko tabaah o barbaad kar diya
Beshak hum ne tumhaari taraf woh kitaab naazil ki hai jis mein khud tumhaara bhi zikr hai, to kya tum itni bhi aql nahin rakhte ho
Aur hum ne kitni hi zaalim bastiyon ko tabaah kar diya aur un ke baad un ki jagah par doosri qaumon ko eejaad kar diya
Phir jab un logon ne azaab ki aahat mehsoos ki to use dekh kar bhaagna shuroo kar diya
Hum ne kaha ke ab bhaago nahin, aur apne gharon ki taraf aur apne saamaan-e-aish o ishrat ki taraf palat kar jaao ke tum se us ke baare mein poochh-gachh ki jaaegi
Un logon ne kaha ke haaye afsos! Hum waaqai zaalim the
Aur yeh keh kar faryaad karte rahe yahaan tak ke hum ne inhein kati hui khaiti ki tarah bana kar un ke saare josh ko thanda kar diya
Aur hum ne aasmaan o zameen aur un ke darmiyaan ki tamaam cheezon ko khel tamaashe ke liye nahin banaaya hai
Hum khel hi banaana chaahte to apni taraf hi se bana lete agar humein aisa karna hota

Balke hum to haq ko baatil ke sar par de maarte hain aur us ke dimaagh ko kuchal dete hain aur woh tabaah o barbaad ho jaata hai, aur tumhaare liye wail hai ke tum aisi be-rabt baatein bayaan kar rahe ho
Aur usi Khuda ke liye zameen o aasmaan ki kul kaainaat hai, aur jo afraad us ki baargaah mein hain woh na us ki ibaadat se akad kar inkaar karte hain aur na thakte hain
Din raat usi ki tasbeeh karte hain aur susti ka bhi shikaar nahin hote hain
Kya un logon ne zameen mein aise khuda bana liye hain jo un ko zinda karne waale hain
Yaad rakho agar zameen o aasmaan mein Allah ke ilaawa aur khuda bhi hote to zameen o aasmaan dono barbaad ho jaate. Arsh ka maalik Parwardigar un ke bayaanaat se bilkul paak o paakeeza hai
Us se baaz-purs karne waala koi nahin hai, aur woh har ek ka hisaab lene waala hai

Kya un logon ne us ke ilaawa aur khuda bana liye hain? To aap keh dijiye ke zara apni daleel to laao. Yeh mere saath waalon ka zikr aur mujh se pehle waalon ka zikr sab maujood hai, lekin un ki aksariyat haq se naawaaqif hai aur isi liye kinaara-kashi kar rahi hai
Aur hum ne aap se pehle koi rasool nahin bheja magar yeh ke us ki taraf yahi wahi karte rahe ke mere ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, lihaaza sab log meri hi ibaadat karo
Aur logon ne yeh kehna shuroo kar diya ke Allah ne kisi ko beta bana liya hai, haalaanke woh is amr se paak o paakeeza hai, balke woh sab us ke mohtaram bande hain
Jo kisi baat par us par sabqat nahin karte hain aur us ke ahkaam par baraabar amal karte rehte hain

Woh un ke saamne aur un ke pas-e-pusht ki tamaam baaton ko jaanta hai, aur farishte kisi ki sifaarish bhi nahin kar sakte magar yeh ke Khuda us ko pasand kare, aur woh us ke khauf se baraabar larazte rehte hain
Aur agar un mein se bhi koi yeh keh de ke Khuda ke ilaawa main bhi khuda hoon to hum us ko bhi Jahannam ki saza denge, ke hum isi tarah zaalimon ko saza diya karte hain
Kya in kaafiron ne yeh nahin dekha ke yeh zameen o aasmaan aapas mein jude hue the aur hum ne un ko alag kiya hai, aur har jaandaar ko paani se qaraar diya hai? Phir kya yeh log imaan na laayenge

Aur hum ne zameen mein pahaad qaraar diye hain ke woh un logon ko le kar kisi taraf jhuk na jaaye, aur phir us mein wasee'-tar raaste qaraar diye hain ke is tarah yeh manzil-e-maqsood tak pahunch sakein
Aur hum ne aasmaan ko ek mahfooz chhat ki tarah banaaya hai, aur yeh log us ki nishaaniyon se baraabar e'raaz kar rahe hain
Woh wahi Khuda hai jis ne raat din aur aaftaab o maahtaab sab ko paida kiya hai, aur sab apne apne falak mein tair rahe hain
Aur hum ne aap se pehle bhi kisi bashar ke liye hameshgi nahin qaraar di hai, to kya agar aap mar jaayenge to yeh log hamesha rehne waale hain
Har nafs maut ka maza chakhne waala hai, aur hum to achchhaai aur buraai ke zariye tum sab ko aazmaayenge, aur tum sab palta kar hamaari hi baargaah mein laaye jaaoge

Aur jab bhi yeh kuffaar aap ko dekhte hain to is baat ka mazaaq udaate hain ke yahi woh shakhs hai jo tumhaare khudaaon ka zikr kiya karta hai, aur yeh log khud to Rehmaan ke zikr se inkaar hi karne waale hain
Insaan ke khameer mein ujlat shaamil ho gayi hai, aur anqareeb hum tumhein apni nishaaniyaan dikhaayenge to phir tum log jaldi nahin karoge
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke agar tum sachche ho to is waada-e-qiyaamat ka waqt aakhir kab aaega
Kaash yeh kaafir yeh jaante ke woh aisa waqt hoga jab yeh Jahannam ki aag ko na apne saamne se hata sakenge aur na pusht se, aur na un ki koi madad ki ja sakegi
Balke yeh qiyaamat un tak achaanak aa jaaegi aur inhein mabhoot kar degi, phir yeh na use radd kar sakenge aur na inhein koi mohlat di jaaegi
Aur Paighambar! Aap se pehle bhi bahut se rasoolon ka mazaaq udaaya gaya hai, jis ke baad un kuffaar ko us azaab ne gher liya jis ka yeh mazaaq uda rahe the
Aap un se keh dijiye ke inhein raat ya din mein Rehmaan ke azaab se bachaane ke liye kaun pehra de sakta hai? Magar yeh hain ke Rehmaan ki yaad se musalsal munh mode hue hain
Kya un ke paas aise khuda maujood hain jo hamaare baghair inhein bacha sakenge? Yeh bechaare to khud apni bhi madad nahin kar sakte hain, aur na inhein khud bhi azaab se panaah di jaaegi

Balke hum ne inhein aur un ke baap daada ko thodi si lazzat-e-duniya de di hai, yahaan tak ke un ka zamaana taweel ho gaya. To kya yeh nahin dekhte hain ke hum baraabar zameen ki taraf aate ja rahe hain aur us ko chaaron taraf se kam karte ja rahe hain? Kya us ke baad bhi yeh hum par ghaalib aa jaane waale hain
Aap keh dijiye ke main tum logon ko wahi ke mutaabiq daraata hoon, aur behre ko jab bhi daraaya jaata hai woh aawaaz ko sunta hi nahin hai
Haalaanke inhein azaab-e-Ilaahi ki hawa bhi chhoo jaaye to keh uthenge ke afsos! Hum waaqai zaalim the

Aur hum qiyaamat ke din insaaf ki taraazu qaaim karenge aur kisi nafs par adna zulm nahin kiya jaaega, aur kisi ka amal raai ke daane ke baraabar bhi hai to hum use le aayenge, aur hum sab ka hisaab karne ke liye kaafi hain

Aur hum ne Moosa alaihis-salaam aur Haaroon alaihis-salaam ko haq o baatil mein farq karne waali woh kitaab ata ki hai jo hidaayat ki raushni aur un saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye yaad-e-Ilaahi ka zariya hai
Jo az-ghaib apne Parwardigar se darne waale hain aur qiyaamat ke khauf se larzaan hain
Aur yeh Quran ek mubaarak zikr hai jise hum ne naazil kiya hai, to kya tum log is ka bhi inkaar karne waale ho
Aur hum ne Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ko is se pehle hi aql-e-saleem ata kar di thi, aur hum un ki haalat se baakhabar the
Jab unhon ne apne murabbi baap aur apni qaum se kaha ke yeh moortiyaan kya hain jin ke gird tum halqa baandhe hue ho
Un logon ne kaha ke hum ne apne baap daada ko bhi unhi ki ibaadat karte hue dekha hai
Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke yaqeenan tum aur tumhaare baap daada sab khuli hui gumraahi mein ho
Un logon ne kaha ke aap koi haq baat le kar aaye hain ya khaali khel tamaasha hi karne waale hain
Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke tumhaara waaqai Rab wahi hai jo aasmaan o zameen ka Rab hai, aur usi ne un sab ko paida kiya hai, aur main isi baat ke gawaahon mein se ek gawaah hoon
Aur Khuda ki qasam! Main tumhaare buton ke baare mein tumhaare chale jaane ke baad koi tadbeer zaroor karoonga
Phir Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne un ke bade ke ilaawa sab ko choor choor kar diya ke shaayad yeh log palat kar us ke paas aayein
Un logon ne kaha ke hamaare khudaaon ke saath yeh bartaao kis ne kiya hai? Woh yaqeenan zaalimeen mein se hai
Logon ne bataaya ke ek jawaan hai jo un ka zikr kiya karta hai aur use Ibraheem kaha jaata hai
Un logon ne kaha ke use logon ke saamne le aao, shaayad log gawaahi de sakein
Phir un logon ne Ibraheem alaihis-salaam se kaha ke kya tum ne hamaare khudaaon ke saath yeh bartaao kiya hai
Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke yeh un ke bade ne kiya hai, tum un se daryaaft kar ke dekho agar yeh bol sakein
Is par un logon ne apne dilon ki taraf rujoo kiya aur aapas mein kehne lage ke yaqeenan tum hi log zaalim ho
Us ke baad un ke sar sharm se jhuka diye gaye aur kehne lage: Ibraheem! Tumhein to maaloom hai ke yeh bolne waale nahin hain
Ibraheem ne kaha ke phir tum Khuda ko chhod kar aise khudaaon ki ibaadat kyon karte ho jo na koi faaida pahuncha sakte hain aur na nuqsaan
Haif hai tumhaare oopar aur tumhaare un khudaaon par jinhein tum ne Khuda-e-barhaq ko chhod kar ikhtiyaar kiya hai, kya tum itna bhi nahin samajhte ho
Un logon ne kaha ke Ibraheem ko aag mein jala do, aur agar kuch karna chaahte ho to is tarah apne khudaaon ki madad karo
To hum ne bhi hukm diya ke aye aag! Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ke liye sard ho ja aur salaamati ka saamaan ban ja
Aur un logon ne ek makr ka iraada kiya tha to hum ne bhi inhein khasaare waala aur naakaam qaraar de diya
Aur Ibraheem alaihis-salaam aur Loot alaihis-salaam ko najaat dila kar us sarzameen ki taraf le aaye jis mein aalameen ke liye barakat ka saamaan maujood tha
Aur phir Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ko Is'haaq alaihis-salaam aur un ke baad Ya'qoob alaihis-salaam ata kiye, aur sab ko saaleh aur nek kirdaar qaraar diya

Aur hum ne un sab ko peshwa qaraar diya jo hamaare hukm se hidaayat karte the, aur un ki taraf kaar-e-khair karne, namaaz qaaim karne aur zakaat ada karne ki wahi ki, aur yeh sab ke sab hamaare ibaadat-guzaar bande the
Aur Loot alaihis-salaam ko yaad karo jinhein hum ne quwwat-e-faisla aur ilm ata kiya, aur us basti se najaat dila di jo badkaariyon mein mubtala thi, ke yaqeenan yeh log bade bure aur faasiq the
Aur hum ne inhein apni rehmat mein daakhil kar liya ke woh yaqeenan hamaare nek kirdaar bandon mein se the
Aur Nooh alaihis-salaam ko yaad karo ke jab unhon ne pehle hi hum ko aawaaz di aur hum ne un ki guzaarish qubool kar li aur inhein aur un ke ahl ko bahut bade karb se najaat dila di
Aur un logon ke muqaable mein un ki madad ki jo hamaari aayaton ki takzeeb kiya karte the, ke yeh log bahut buri qaum the, to hum ne un sab ko gharq kar diya

Aur Dawood alaihis-salaam aur Sulaimaan alaihis-salaam ko yaad karo jab woh dono ek khaiti ke baare mein faisla kar rahe the jab khet mein qaum ki bakriyaan ghus gayi thin, aur hum un ke faisle ko dekh rahe the

Phir hum ne Sulaimaan alaihis-salaam ko saheeh faisla samjha diya, aur hum ne sab ko quwwat-e-faisla aur ilm ata kiya tha, aur Dawood alaihis-salaam ke saath pahaadon ko musakhkhar kar diya tha ke woh tasbeeh-e-Parwardigar karein, aur tuyoor ko bhi musakhkhar kar diya tha, aur hum aise kaam karte rehte hain
Aur hum ne inhein zirah banaane ki san'at ta'leem de di taake woh tum ko jang ke khatraat se mahfooz rakh sake, to kya tum hamaare shukr-guzaar bande banoge
Aur Sulaimaan ke liye tez o tund hawaaon ko musakhkhar kar diya jo un ke hukm se us sarzameen ki taraf chalti thin jis mein hum ne barakatein rakhi thin, aur hum har shai ke jaanne waale hain
Aur ba'z jinnaat ko bhi musakhkhar kar diya jo samandar mein ghote lagaaya karte the aur us ke ilaawa doosre kaam bhi anjaam diya karte the, aur hum un sab ke nigehbaan the
Aur Ayyoob alaihis-salaam ko yaad karo jab unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko pukaara ke mujhe beemaari ne chhoo liya hai aur tu behtareen rahm karne waala hai

To hum ne un ki dua ko qubool kar liya aur un ki beemaari ko door kar diya, aur inhein un ke ahl o ayaal de diye aur waise hi aur bhi de diye, ke yeh hamaari taraf se khaas meharbaani thi, aur yeh ibaadat-guzaar bandon ke liye ek yaad-dahaani hai
Aur Ismaaeel alaihis-salaam o Idrees alaihis-salaam o Zul-Kifl alaihis-salaam ko yaad karo ke yeh sab sabr karne waalon mein se the
Aur sab ko hum ne apni rehmat mein daakhil kar liya tha, aur yaqeenan yeh sab hamaare nek kirdaar bandon mein se the

Aur Yunus alaihis-salaam ko yaad karo ke jab woh ghusse mein aa kar chale aur yeh khayaal kiya ke hum un par rozi tang na karenge, aur phir taareekiyon mein ja kar aawaaz di ke Parwardigar! Tere ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, tu paak o be-niyaaz hai, aur main apne nafs par zulm karne waalon mein se tha
To hum ne un ki dua ko qubool kar liya aur inhein gham se najaat dila di, ke hum isi tarah saahibaan-e-imaan ko najaat dilaate rehte hain
Aur Zakariya alaihis-salaam ko yaad karo ke jab unhon ne apne Rab ko pukaara ke Parwardigar! Mujhe akela na chhod dena ke tu tamaam waarison se behtar waaris hai

To hum ne un ki dua ko bhi qubool kar liya aur inhein Yahya alaihis-salaam jaisa farzand ata kar diya, aur un ki zauja ko saaleha bana diya. Ke yeh tamaam woh the jo nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karne waale the, aur raghbat aur khauf ke har aalam mein hum hi ko pukaarne waale the, aur hamaari baargaah mein gidgida kar iltija karne waale bande the
Aur us khaatoon ko yaad karo jis ne apni sharm ki hifaazat ki, to hum ne us mein apni taraf se rooh phoonk di, aur use aur us ke farzand ko tamaam aalameen ke liye apni nishaani qaraar de diya
Beshak yeh tumhaara deen ek hi deen-e-Islam hai, aur main tum sab ka Parwardigar hoon, lihaaza meri hi ibaadat kiya karo
Aur un logon ne to apne deen ko bhi aapas mein tukde tukde kar liya hai, haalaanke yeh sab palat kar hamaari hi baargaah mein aane waale hain
Phir jo shakhs saahib-e-imaan reh kar nek amal karega us ki koshish barbaad na hogi, aur hum us ki koshish ko baraabar likh rahe hain
Aur jis basti ko hum ne tabaah kar diya hai us ke liye bhi na-mumkin hai ke qiyaamat ke din hamaare paas palat kar na aaye
Yahaan tak ke Yaajooj Maajooj aazaad kar diye jaayenge aur zameen ki har bulandi se daudte hue nikal padenge

Aur Allah ka sachcha waada qareeb aa jaaega, to sab dekhenge ke kuffaar ki aankhein pathra gayi hain, aur woh keh rahe hain ke waae bar haal-e-maa! Hum is taraf se bilkul ghaflat mein pade hue the, balke hum apne nafs par zulm karne waale the
Yaad rakho ke tum log khud aur jin cheezon ki tum parastish kar rahe ho sab ko Jahannam ka eendhan banaaya jaaega, aur tum sab usi mein waarid hone waale ho
Agar yeh sab waaqai khuda hote to kabhi Jahannam mein waarid na hote, haalaanke yeh sab usi mein hamesha hamesha rehne waale hain
Jahannam mein un ke liye cheekh pukaar hogi aur woh kisi ki baat sunne ke qaabil na honge
Beshak jin logon ke haq mein hamaari taraf se pehle hi neki muqaddar ho chuki hai woh is Jahannam se door rakhe jaayenge
Aur us ki bhanak bhi na sunenge, aur apni hasb-e-khwaahish ne'maton mein hamesha hamesha aaraam se rahenge
Inhein qiyaamat ka bade se bada haulnaak manzar bhi ranjeeda na kar sakega, aur un se malaaika is tarah mulaaqaat karenge ke yahi woh din hai jis ka tum se waada kiya gaya tha

Us din hum tamaam aasmaanon ko is tarah lapet denge jis tarah khaton ka toomaar lapeta jaata hai, aur jis tarah hum ne takhleeq ki ibtida ki hai usi tarah inhein waapas bhi le aayenge. Yeh hamaare zimme ek waada hai jis par hum bahar-haal amal karne waale hain
Aur hum ne zikr ke baad Zaboor mein bhi likh diya hai ke hamaari zameen ke waaris hamaare nek bande hi honge
Yaqeenan is mein ibaadat-guzaar qaum ke liye ek paighaam hai
Aur hum ne aap ko aalameen ke liye sirf rehmat bana kar bheja hai
Aap keh dijiye ke hamaari taraf sirf yeh wahi aati hai ke tumhaara khuda ek hai, to kya tum Islam laane waale ho
Phir agar yeh munh mod lein to keh dijiye ke hum ne tum sab ko baraabar se aagaah kar diya hai. Ab mujhe nahin maaloom ke jis azaab ka waada kiya gaya hai woh qareeb hai ya door hai
Beshak woh Khuda un baaton ko bhi jaanta hai jin ka izhaar kiya jaata hai aur un baaton ko bhi jaanta hai jin ko yeh log chhupa rahe hain
Aur main kuch nahin jaanta, shaayad yeh taakheer-e-azaab bhi ek tarah ka imtehaan ho ya ek muddat-e-mu'ayyan tak ka aaraam ho
Phir paighambar ne dua ki ke Parwardigar! Hamaare darmiyaan haq ke saath faisla kar de, aur hamaara Rab yaqeenan meharbaan aur tumhaari baaton ke muqaable mein qaabil-e-isti'aanat hai
